packing_failure.message: no legal start: no initial layouts and the MILP found no layout

validation.scope: Related existing tests plus bounded controls; no full-suite or remote experiment rerun.

reproduction.packing: Problem with two 6x6 mm dies, 1 W each, original carrier 12x12 mm, centres (3,3)/(9,3) mm, zero rotations and centre pins, limit 100 C. try_carrier on 10x10 mm, gap 0, length budget 0.02 m, relation_space, budget 10, size_s 1, threads/workers 1, resolution 16, chain_steps 1, seed 2.
reproduction.cost: Construct anchor.ok=true, anchor.carrier_mm=[52,33], history and best containing only certified [41.1,41.1]. Reprice with default CostParams except seam_yield=0.95. Compare against the same anchor; include anchor to correct candidate pool.
reproduction.tolerance: tests/sizing_unittest.small_problem, grid centres (10,10)/(30,10)/(10,30)/(30,30) mm, rotation 0, gap 500 um, FV resolution 16. Limit is measured anchor peak minus 1e-9 K; use exact anchor pin length. fixed_aspect with BISECTION_STEPS patched to 0 and budget 10.
reproduction.small_budget: Same four-die control, restore limit to measured peak, budget 1, compare fixed_aspect against anchored(inner=blind, workers=1, resolution=16).

concurrent_work: During review, uncommitted edits appeared in cosize.py, run_cosize.py and cosize_unittest.py. They address anchor tolerance, relation_space per-trial budget, and refinement when all trials succeed. They were preserved; controls and the 11-test run refer to the published snapshot.
